messages: ellie: quick question for the group — thinking about the Create API key form: do we validate fields inline as the user types or only show an error summary after submit? i like inline for fast fixes but worried about visual noise on longer flows. samir: inline for single-line fields (name, email) but summary on submit for multi-step flows. reduces interruption. maria: accessibility note: asterisks alone aren't great for screen readers. prefer explicit 'Required' visible + sr-only text for labels. kai: +1. regardless of pattern, ensure aria-invalid, focus to the first error, and announce total errors via aria-live on submit. ellie: what about a hybrid approach: lightweight inline hints while typing (one-liners) and a grouped error summary on submit that links to the fields. gives both local and global context. samir: hybrid sounds right. microcopy tone: let's standardize to concise, directive language e.g. 'Enter a valid email' vs apologetic phrasing. maria: agreed. also need to define when to require typed confirmations for destructive actions. full type-to-confirm is safe but high friction. kai: recommend risk-based friction: simple modal for low-risk deletes, typed confirmation for org-wide or irreversible operations. document this in patterns. ellie: proposed pattern doc: low-risk = modal with clear consequence text; high-risk = type-to-confirm. i'll add examples and edge cases. uxbot: [deploy-bot] design tokens updated: form-error / form-hint semantic colors deployed. samir: UI question — how to show required fields? asterisk plus a11y-friendly label or just explicit 'Required' pill? maria: let's do asterisk visually and add required in the DOM for screen readers. avoid title attributes. kai: code snippet for copy into the component library: Enter a valid email ellie: nice. also ensure role="alert" only appears after submit so it doesn't interrupt normal typing. maria: microcopy suggestions for the library: inline: 'Enter a valid value'; summary: 'We found 2 problems. Fix the highlighted fields below.'; destructive primary label: 'Delete API key' (red) secondary: 'Cancel'. samir: keep hint styling distinct from error styling. don't use full red for hints. ellie: will add separate tokens and a visual distinction for hint vs error + iconography. kai: checklist for the PR: aria-invalid, focus-first-error, error-summary anchor links with data-qa ids, aria-live/role=status for non-critical hints, contrast AA for error text, keyboard focus for modals. maria: testability nit: anchor links in error summary should have stable data-qa ids so e2e can target them. ellie: next steps: i'll draft the pattern page update with the hybrid validation approach, add the microcopy table, and open a small PR with the snippet and tokens. owners: @ellie (author), reviewers @maria & @kai. target: next sprint. samir: good plan — tagging design-ops to fold this into the console patterns. :+1:
